title: OPS-02 Dataset Reproducibility, Regeneration, and Epistemic Boundary Audit

artifact_integrity.evidence: All 212 GeoTIFF images and 212 PNG masks physically exist on disk, are readable without error, have expected shapes (256, 256) and dtypes (float32, uint8), and have SHA-256 checksums matching the authoritative manifest with 0 mismatches.

regeneration_reproducibility.evidence: Code in scripts/assemble_ops02_c14_dataset.py deterministically specifies the source product URL resolution on AWS Open Data S3 (sentinel-s1-l1c), the 2560x2560 window crop geometry, 10x10 block-mean aggregation, and mask remapping. Regeneration from remote S3 requires network reachability and stable AWS Open Data URLs.

scientific_reproducibility.evidence: Semantic phenomenon boundaries originate from Li et al. (2020) manual expert annotations. The annotations are treated as authoritative Tier-A labels but have not been independently re-annotated from scratch or co-registered with high-resolution optical / AIS ship tracking.

deterministic_parameters.raw_measurement_source: Copernicus Sentinel-1 Level-1 GRD IW mode (AWS Open Data sentinel-s1-l1c)

limitations.georeferencing_status: Relative pixel grid alignment is strongly supported; absolute georeferencing in the GeoTIFF headers is an engineering placeholder transform and should not be used for precision geographic GIS overlay without applying native Sentinel-1 GCP / orbit geocoding.
limitations.single_archive_grounding: OPS-02 is an expansion of independent acquisitions within the Li IW archive; it does NOT constitute an independent multi-source benchmark.
